title: Cooperative membership and skill transmission: evidence from apprenticeship among agricultural machinery operators in China
title_zh: 合作社成员资格与技能传播：来自中国农业机械操作员学徒制的证据
title_primary: 合作社成员资格与技能传播：来自中国农业机械操作员学徒制的证据
title_secondary: Cooperative membership and skill transmission: evidence from apprenticeship among agricultural machinery operators in China
authors: Peng Yuan, Guangqiao Cao, Shiyi Shen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agricultural machinery operators constitute a crucial skilled workforce for mechanization service provision, but population ageing and rural labour outmigration are threatening the continuity of this workforce and the transmission of its operational skills. Using survey data from 2,458 agricultural machinery operators across five provinces in China, this study examines whether cooperative membership promotes apprenticeship-based skill transmission. The baseline results show that cooperative membership is significantly and positively associated with skill transmission. The results are robust to IV Poisson estimation, propensity score matching, and a negative binomial specification. Mechanism analysis suggests that cooperative membership may promote skill transmission by enhancing operators’ occupational identity and expanding their business volume. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that this positive association is stronger among multi-skilled operators and non-cross-regional operators. Additional analysis of operators who have not yet trained apprentices indicates that cooperative membership also increases their willingness and plans for future skill transmission. These findings suggest that cooperatives not only organize mechanization services and facilitate technology diffusion, but also serve as important platforms for agricultural human capital formation. KEYWORDS: Skill transmission apprenticeship training cooperative membership agricultural mechanization agricultural machinery operators JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J43 O15
abstract_zh: 农业机械操作人员是机械化服务供给的关键技能型劳动力，但人口老龄化和农村劳动力外流正威胁着这一劳动力队伍的延续及其操作技能的传承。利用中国五省2458名农业机械操作人员的调查数据，本研究考察了合作社成员身份是否促进基于学徒制的技能传承。基准结果表明，合作社成员身份与技能传承呈显著正相关。该结果在工具变量泊松估计、倾向得分匹配和负二项回归设定下均保持稳健。机制分析表明，合作社成员身份可能通过增强操作人员的职业认同感和扩大其业务规模来促进技能传承。异质性分析进一步显示，这一正向关联在多项技能操作人员和跨区域作业操作人员中更为显著。对尚未培养学徒的操作人员的补充分析表明，合作社成员身份也提高了他们未来进行技能传承的意愿和计划。这些研究发现表明，合作社不仅组织机械化服务并促进技术扩散，还充当农业人力资本形成的重要平台。关键词：技能传承 学徒培训 合作社成员身份 农业机械化 农业机械操作人员 JEL分类：J24 J43 O15

title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
title_zh: 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融
title_primary: 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融
title_secondary: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
authors: Annamaria Lusardi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This article provides an overview of the literature on financial literacy. It covers the initial measurement that created the Big Three questions and measures of personal finance knowledge featuring 28 questions. It shows that levels of financial literacy are low and have not been improving over time. This is true not only in the United States but also in countries worldwide. These findings matter because financial literacy is conducive to savvy financial behaviors, from holding precautionary savings to planning for retirement to many other financial decisions. Financial education programs have grown exponentially over time, providing important insights into their cost-effectiveness. Personal finance courses have been added to high school and college curricula, and the evidence indicates that they are useful initiatives to improve financial knowledge and downstream behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文对金融素养相关文献进行了综述。它涵盖了最初构建“三大问题”的测量方法，以及包含28个问题的个人财务知识测量指标。研究表明，金融素养水平普遍较低，且随时间推移并未得到改善。这一现象不仅存在于美国，也见于全球各国。这些发现之所以重要，是因为金融素养有助于促进明智的财务行为，从持有预防性储蓄到规划退休，乃至其他众多财务决策。金融教育项目随时间呈指数级增长，为其成本效益提供了重要见解。个人理财课程已被纳入高中和大学课程体系，证据表明，这些举措对于提升财务知识及后续行为具有积极作用。

title: External dependence of China’s ocean Industries
title_zh: 中国海洋产业的外部依赖性
title_primary: 中国海洋产业的外部依赖性
title_secondary: External dependence of China’s ocean Industries
authors: Chuanzeng Zheng, Xiaoying Liang, Li Zheng, Kunfu Zhu, Miaochan Li 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: China hosts the world’s largest and fastest-growing ocean economy, yet it now confronts heightening external trade risks driven by global growing instability. To understand its potential risk from external shocks, this study evaluates the dependence of China’s ocean economy from both forward and backward perspectives and assesses the potential impacts of a U.S.A.–China decoupling based on a provincial ocean economy input–output table. The findings indicate that: 1) the forward external dependence (0.12) is higher than its backward external dependence (0.08), revealing that China’s ocean economy is more sensitive to fluctuations in external market demand than to disruptions in the external supply. 2) The external dependence exhibits significant regional and sectoral heterogeneity. While Guangdong and Shanghai show high external dependence, incorporating HHI concentration reveals that Jiangsu, Liaoning, and Shandong possess greater structural vulnerability. Industries such as marine shipbuilding (forward) and marine chemical (backward) are the most externally exposed industries. 3) The U.S.A.–China decoupling would significantly reduce total output of China’s ocean economy, particularly in marine transport and chemicals; however, scenario simulations confirm that global trade substitution can effectively mitigate a substantial portion of these losses. These findings provide policy insights for managing external risks and strengthening industrial resilience. KEYWORDS: China’s ocean industries external dependence ocean economy input-output table U.S.A–China decoupling JEL CLASSIFICATION: D57 R15
abstract_zh: 中国拥有全球规模最大、增长最快的海洋经济，但当前全球不稳定加剧使其面临日益严峻的外部贸易风险。为理解外部冲击的潜在风险，本研究基于省级海洋经济投入产出表，从前向与后向两个维度评估中国海洋经济的外部依赖度，并测算中美脱钩的潜在影响。研究发现：1）前向外部依赖度（0.12）高于后向外部依赖度（0.08），表明中国海洋经济对外部市场需求波动的敏感度高于外部供给中断。2）外部依赖度呈现显著的区域与行业异质性。广东和上海的外部依赖度较高，但引入赫芬达尔指数（HHI）集中度分析后，江苏、辽宁和山东的结构脆弱性更为突出。海洋船舶制造（前向）与海洋化工（后向）是外部暴露程度最高的行业。3）中美脱钩将显著降低中国海洋经济总产出，尤其对海洋运输和化工行业冲击最大；但情景模拟证实，全球贸易替代可有效弥补大部分损失。上述结论为应对外部风险、增强产业韧性提供了政策启示。关键词：中国海洋产业；外部依赖度；海洋经济；投入产出表；中美脱钩 JEL分类：D57；R15

title: Spillovers from Science
title_primary: 科学的溢出效应
authors: Dennis Verhoeven, Anna Valero, Ralf Martin, Arjun Shah
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Quantifying spillovers from scientific knowledge to technology is important for understanding the social returns to science and for designing policy. A key challenge is how to credit scientific work with the value generated in downstream technologies when ideas diffuse through chains of follow-on research. We propose a new measure---Science Rank---that uses the combined patent and paper citation network to assign a share of the private value of patented inventions to the scientific papers they directly or indirectly rely on. Validated against various types of scientific awards, the measure substantially outperforms direct patent-to-paper citation counts in identifying influential science. We document large heterogeneity in spillovers across countries, disciplines, and institutions. The US emerges from our analysis as a powerhouse of science spillovers, benefiting both domestic and foreign technology development. We apply our methodology to examine how different countries and individual institutions contribute to innovation that addresses global challenges such as climate change or more equal economic development. We find that a relatively large share of the total value generated by research in Lower and Middle Income Country (LMIC) feeds into climate change related innovation. We also highlight countries and institutions that are making particular contributions to LMIC innovation.
abstract_zh: 量化科学知识向技术的溢出效应，对于理解科学的社会回报以及制定相关政策至关重要。当思想通过后续研究的链条传播时，如何将下游技术产生的价值归功于科学工作，是一个关键挑战。我们提出了一种新指标——科学排名（Science Rank）——利用专利与论文的联合引用网络，将专利发明的私人价值份额分配给其直接或间接依赖的科学论文。经多种科学奖项验证，该指标在识别具有影响力的科学成果方面，显著优于直接的专利-论文引用计数。我们记录了不同国家、学科和机构之间溢出效应的巨大异质性。分析显示，美国是科学溢出的强国，其科学成果惠及国内外技术发展。我们应用该方法考察了不同国家和机构如何为应对气候变化或促进更公平经济发展等全球挑战的创新做出贡献。研究发现，中低收入国家（LMIC）研究产生的总价值中，有相对较大的一部分流向了与气候变化相关的创新。我们还重点指出了那些为LMIC创新做出特殊贡献的国家和机构。

authors: Tom Ahn, Jesse M. Cunha, Patrick Veith
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the influence of workplace peers on a high-stakes, irreversible retirement plan choice. Midcareer U.S. military personnel choose between higher future pension payouts or an immediate bonus plus lower future payouts. With peers defined as those who have locked in their choices and personnel assignment rules ensuring that peer groups are exogenously formed, we capture the causal impact of peers. Greater peer take-up of the bonus, which is difficult to compare to the alternative plan but often extremely costly over one’s lifetime, discourages choosers from selecting the bonus. Peers have special impact within professional, race, and gender groups.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了工作场所同伴对一项高风险的、不可逆的退休计划选择的影响。美国军队中的职业生涯中期人员需要在更高的未来养老金支付与即时奖金加较低的未来支付之间做出选择。我们将同伴定义为那些已经锁定自己选择的人员，并且由于人员分配规则确保了同伴群体是外生形成的，我们捕捉到了同伴的因果影响。同伴对奖金的接受率更高——尽管这种奖金与替代计划难以比较，且通常在一生中代价极高——会抑制选择者选择奖金。同伴在职业、种族和性别群体内具有特殊影响。

title: Supply chain competition and the welfare effects of partial ownership
title_zh: 供应链竞争与部分所有权的福利效应
title_primary: 供应链竞争与部分所有权的福利效应
title_secondary: Supply chain competition and the welfare effects of partial ownership
authors: Changying Li, Yue Li, Larry D. Qiu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the competition and welfare effects of upstream partial ownerships (UPO) in a framework with two competing supply chains and downstream firms choosing their product positionings strategically. We find that UPO reduces downstream product differentiation and thus intensifies downstream competition. Unlike the standard results of Bertrand competition, we find that downstream prices can be strategic substitutes even when downstream firms compete in Bertrand fashion. More importantly, we show that UPO increases consumer surplus and social welfare, even when double marginalization increases downstream prices. The competition and welfare results from downstream partial ownerships (DPO) are just the opposite to those from UPO. Our findings have clear managerial and policy implications.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了上游部分所有权（UPO）在两条竞争性供应链框架下的竞争与福利效应，其中下游企业战略性选择产品定位。研究发现，UPO会降低下游产品差异化程度，从而加剧下游竞争。与伯特兰竞争的标准结论不同，我们发现即使下游企业以伯特兰方式竞争，下游价格仍可能呈现战略替代性。更重要的是，我们证明即使双重边际化推高了下游价格，UPO仍能提升消费者剩余和社会福利。下游部分所有权（DPO）的竞争与福利效应则与UPO完全相反。本研究具有明确的管理与政策启示。

title: China Shock or China Boost? Intermediate Inputs and Manufacturing Resilience in Poland
title_zh: 中国冲击还是中国助推？中间投入与波兰制造业韧性
title_primary: 中国冲击还是中国助推？中间投入与波兰制造业韧性
title_secondary: China Shock or China Boost? Intermediate Inputs and Manufacturing Resilience in Poland
authors: Chencen Guo, Hong Ma
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We analyze the effects of increased trade exposure to China on the Polish labor market during the period 2011–2019. Utilizing detailed industry-level data and an instrumental variable strategy based on trade flows from other Visegrad Group countries, we disentangle the impacts of import competition and access to imported intermediate inputs. We find that while import competition induced job losses in specific sectors, industries benefiting from access to Chinese intermediate inputs experienced substantial employment gains. Critically, this positive input channel effect was sufficient to offset the majority of displacement losses caused by import competition. Although manufacturing as a whole faced a slight net decline, the aggregate economy experienced net employment expansion. These results identify a “China Boost” driven by intermediate inputs, suggesting that Chinese imports act as strategic complements to domestic labor in Poland, contrasting sharply with the “China Shock” observed in the United States.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了2011-2019年间中国贸易敞口增加对波兰劳动力市场的影响。利用详细的行业层面数据，并基于维谢格拉德集团其他国家的贸易流量构建工具变量策略，我们区分了进口竞争与进口中间品获取的影响。研究发现，尽管进口竞争导致特定行业就业岗位流失，但受益于中国中间品输入的行业却实现了显著的就业增长。关键在于，这种正向的投入渠道效应足以抵消进口竞争造成的大部分岗位替代损失。虽然制造业整体面临轻微净下降，但总体经济却经历了就业扩张。这些结果揭示了由中间品驱动的"中国助推"效应，表明中国进口品与波兰国内劳动力形成战略互补关系，这与美国观察到的"中国冲击"形成鲜明对比。

title: Can artificial intelligence replace human labour? Global evidence from 65 countries
title_zh: 人工智能能否替代人类劳动？来自65个国家的全球证据
title_primary: 人工智能能否替代人类劳动？来自65个国家的全球证据
title_secondary: Can artificial intelligence replace human labour? Global evidence from 65 countries
authors: Quoc Hoi Le, Cong Minh Huynh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite growing concerns about technological unemployment, existing evidence remains fragmented, country-specific, and largely silent on whether productivity growth driven by artificial intelligence (AI) can decouple from human labour globally. This paper provides new global evidence on AI-labour substitution using an unbalanced panel of 65 countries over 2013–2023. Building on a task-based theoretical framework, we conceptualize AI as a potentially labour-replacing technology that reallocates economic tasks from humans to machines. We test this framework empirically using AI development, combined with cross-country data on labour force participation, productivity, human capital, and institutional characteristics. The results reveal three main findings. First, AI development is associated with a statistically significant decrease in labour force participation, indicating the presence of labour displacement effects. Second, AI simultaneously raises productivity, pointing to productivity-labour decoupling, whereby output growth becomes less dependent on human labour. Third, human capital and governance quality play crucial moderating roles in weakening labour-displacing effects of AI. Remarkably, dynamic panel estimates suggest that AI induces short-run labour displacement, while long-run outcomes depend on countries’ capacity to adapt through education and institutional quality.
abstract_zh: 尽管对技术性失业的担忧日益加剧，现有证据仍显零散、局限于特定国家，且在很大程度上未能阐明由人工智能（AI）驱动的生产率增长能否在全球范围内与人类劳动脱钩。本文利用2013至2023年间65个国家的非平衡面板数据，为AI与劳动替代提供了新的全球证据。基于任务型理论框架，我们将AI概念化为一种可能替代劳动力的技术，它将经济任务从人类重新分配至机器。我们通过AI发展指标，结合各国劳动力参与率、生产率、人力资本及制度特征等跨国数据，对该框架进行了实证检验。结果揭示了三个主要发现。首先，AI发展与劳动力参与率的统计显著下降相关联，表明存在劳动替代效应。其次，AI同时提升了生产率，指向生产率与劳动的脱钩，即产出增长对人类劳动的依赖减弱。第三，人力资本和治理质量在削弱AI的劳动替代效应中发挥着关键调节作用。值得注意的是，动态面板估计表明，AI在短期内引发劳动替代，而长期结果则取决于各国通过教育和制度质量进行适应的能力。

title: Agricultural Vulnerability Assessment: Climate and Non‐Climate Interactions in Crop Production Systems
title_zh: 农业脆弱性评估：作物生产系统中气候与非气候因素的交互作用
title_primary: 农业脆弱性评估：作物生产系统中气候与非气候因素的交互作用
title_secondary: Agricultural Vulnerability Assessment: Climate and Non‐Climate Interactions in Crop Production Systems
authors: Mahdieh Khezri‐nejad‐gharaei, Bouali Guesmi, Jeroen Buysse, Jose Maria Gil Roig
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-05-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Recent climate phenomena show that Spain is one of the most vulnerable countries to climate change impacts, with varied regional effects from flash floods to drought. This study assesses the vulnerability of four major crops (cereal, rice, grape and olive) in Catalonia to climate change through a comprehensive vulnerability index incorporating exposure, sensitivity and adaptive capacity indicators. Using farm‐level panel data from 2012 to 2022, we employ a three‐stage analytical approach using a multi‐criteria vulnerability index, correlation analysis and dynamic panel estimation to examine the relationship between vulnerability and total factor productivity (TFP). Results reveal significant differences in vulnerability across crops and provinces, with olive showing the highest vulnerability followed by cereal, whereas grape demonstrates the lowest vulnerability. Lleida province exhibits the highest regional vulnerability, whereas Barcelona shows the lowest. Temperature‐related factors emerge as the dominant vulnerability drivers, with extreme temperature days and temperature variability followed by topographical limitations. System GMM estimation confirms a strong negative relationship between vulnerability and agricultural productivity, with long‐term impacts exceeding immediate effects. These findings provide a foundation for targeted adaptation strategies that address both climate exposure and adaptive capacity constraints, enabling policymakers to prioritise interventions based on crop‐specific vulnerability profiles and key driving factors.
abstract_zh: 近期气候现象表明，西班牙是受气候变化影响最脆弱的国家之一，其区域效应从山洪暴发到干旱各不相同。本研究通过构建包含暴露度、敏感性和适应能力指标的综合脆弱性指数，评估了加泰罗尼亚地区四种主要作物（谷物、水稻、葡萄和橄榄）对气候变化的脆弱性。利用2012年至2022年的农场层面面板数据，我们采用三阶段分析方法——包括多准则脆弱性指数、相关性分析和动态面板估计——来考察脆弱性与全要素生产率之间的关系。结果显示，不同作物和省份的脆弱性存在显著差异，其中橄榄的脆弱性最高，其次是谷物，而葡萄的脆弱性最低。莱里达省的区域脆弱性最高，而巴塞罗那省最低。温度相关因素成为主要的脆弱性驱动因素，其中极端温度天数和温度变异性影响最大，其次是地形限制。系统GMM估计证实了脆弱性与农业生产力之间存在强烈的负相关关系，且长期影响超过短期效应。这些发现为制定针对性的适应策略提供了基础，这些策略需同时应对气候暴露度和适应能力限制，使政策制定者能够根据作物特定的脆弱性概况和关键驱动因素优先安排干预措施。

official: 官方在线 2026-05-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I study a novel two‐way feedback between credit and labor market frictions. Running from credit to labor markets, amplitude in capital demand caused by collateral constraints spills over onto labor demand due to the complementarity of capital and labor; and, furthermore, credit frictions raise effective financial hiring costs, prompting firms to delay hiring in recessions. Running back from labor to credit markets, search frictions imply that wages move less than one‐to‐one with productivity; this induces greater volatility of net worth, via the wage bill, which then spills over onto capital demand. Together, these considerably amplify labor and capital market dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文研究信贷摩擦与劳动力市场摩擦之间一种新颖的双向反馈机制。从信贷市场向劳动力市场的传导路径中，抵押约束引发的资本需求波动会通过资本与劳动的互补性溢出至劳动力需求；此外，信贷摩擦提高了有效金融雇佣成本，促使企业在经济衰退期延迟招聘。从劳动力市场向信贷市场的反向传导路径中，搜寻摩擦导致工资变动幅度小于生产率变动幅度，这通过工资账单渠道加剧了净值的波动性，进而溢出至资本需求。两种机制共同作用，显著放大了劳动力市场与资本市场的动态波动。

title: RPM and Vertical Integration With Upstream Competition and Noncontractible Efforts
title_zh: 上游竞争与非契约努力下的转售价格维持与纵向整合
title_primary: 上游竞争与非契约努力下的转售价格维持与纵向整合
title_secondary: RPM and Vertical Integration With Upstream Competition and Noncontractible Efforts
authors: Michele Bisceglia, Mark Israel, Salvatore Piccolo, Paolo Ramezzana
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study RPM and vertical integration in a common agency setting with two differentiated manufacturers and one retailer, where consumer demand depends on both the manufacturers' and retailer's noncontractible efforts. Under vertical separation, the adoption of maximum RPM by both manufacturers is an equilibrium and intensifies competition, since manufacturing margins are positive to incentivize manufacturing effort. This benefits consumers and may lower industry profits relative to a scenario where RPM is not available. Vertical integration between the retailer and one of the manufacturers increases industry profits and, when retail effort is also important, may benefit consumers by mitigating double marginalization.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两家差异化制造商和一家零售商的共同代理框架下的转售价格维持（RPM）与纵向一体化问题，其中消费者需求同时取决于制造商和零售商不可契约化的努力水平。在纵向分离情形下，两家制造商均采用最高转售价格维持构成均衡状态，并加剧了市场竞争——这是因为制造商需维持正利润空间以激励其努力投入。相较于无法实施RPM的情形，这种机制使消费者获益，但可能降低行业整体利润。当零售商与其中一家制造商实现纵向一体化时，行业利润得以提升；若零售努力同样重要，该模式还能通过缓解双重边际化效应使消费者受益。

title: Microcredit From Delaying Bill Payments
title_zh: 延迟支付账单的小额信贷
title_primary: 延迟支付账单的小额信贷
authors: William Violette
official: 官方在线 2026-05-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Delaying bill payments to public utilities may provide an important strategy for households with volatile incomes to smooth their consumption. At the same time, allowing late payments may reduce net revenues for utilities, which often leads to higher prices to cover costs. Using billing records from a large water utility in Manila, this paper estimates a household consumption and savings model to evaluate counterfactual payment policies. A popular proposal to ensure upfront payments—prepaid metering—recoups less revenue than is needed to compensate households for their loss of consumption smoothing. Alternatively, a revenue-neutral policy allowing more late payments increases welfare by encouraging greater consumption smoothing.
abstract_zh: 延迟支付公共事业账单可能为收入波动较大的家庭提供一种重要的消费平滑策略。同时，允许延迟支付可能会减少公用事业公司的净收入，这往往导致价格上涨以覆盖成本。利用马尼拉一家大型水务公司的账单记录，本文估计了一个家庭消费与储蓄模型，以评估反事实支付政策。一项确保预付款的流行提议——预付费计量——所回收的收入不足以补偿家庭因失去消费平滑而遭受的损失。相反，一项允许更多延迟支付的收入中性政策通过鼓励更大的消费平滑来增加福利。

title: Earned entitlements and risky investments in bargaining: an experiment
title_zh: 议价中的应得权利与风险投资：一项实验研究
title_primary: 议价中的应得权利与风险投资：一项实验研究
title_secondary: Earned entitlements and risky investments in bargaining: an experiment
authors: Büyükboyacı, Mürüvvet, Karagözoğlu, Emin, Küçükşenel, Serkan
official: 官方在线 2026-04-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In various organizational settings, a team member is given the authority to make an investment decision that influences the value of the jointly produced surplus. We experimentally investigate the effect of asymmetric status, investment decisions, and the outcome of these decisions on bargaining behavior and outcomes. Agents’ initial contributions to the surplus are determined by their relative performances in a real-effort task. Three treatments vary in how the final surplus value is determined. We observe that when low-contributors take a risk, they are punished (rewarded) for failure (success), whereas high-contributors receive a fixed share independent of the outcome. Analysis of bargaining process variables, subjects’ communication during bargaining, and third parties’ normative judgments provides further insights into the possible mechanism behind this observation.
abstract_zh: 在各种组织环境中，团队成员被赋予投资决策权，该决策会影响共同产出剩余的价值。我们通过实验研究了非对称地位、投资决策及其结果对议价行为与结果的影响。代理人对于剩余的初始贡献取决于他们在真实努力任务中的相对表现。三种实验处理通过最终剩余价值的确定方式加以区分。我们观察到，当低贡献者承担风险时，其失败（成功）会受到惩罚（奖励），而高贡献者无论结果如何都能获得固定份额。对议价过程变量、被试在议价过程中的沟通内容以及第三方规范性判断的分析，进一步揭示了这一现象背后可能的作用机制。

title: A Method to Estimate Discrete Choice Models That Is Robust to Consumer Search
title_zh: 一种对消费者搜索行为稳健的离散选择模型估计方法
title_primary: 一种对消费者搜索行为稳健的离散选择模型估计方法
title_secondary: A Method to Estimate Discrete Choice Models That Is Robust to Consumer Search
authors: Jason Abaluck, Giovanni Compiani, Fan Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-01-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We state a sufficient condition under which choice data alone suffices to identify consumer preferences when choices are not fully informed. Suppose that: (i) the data generating process is a search model in which the attribute hidden to consumers is observed by the econometrician; (ii) if a consumer searches good j, she also searches goods which are better than j in terms of the non-hidden component of utility; and (iii) consumers choose the good that maximizes overall utility among searched goods. Canonical models will be biased: the value of the hidden attribute will be understated because consumers will be unresponsive to variation in the attribute for goods that they do not search. Under the conditions above and additional mild restrictions, an alternative method of recovering preferences using cross derivatives of choice probabilities succeeds regardless of the search protocol and is thus robust to whether consumers are informed. The approach nests several standard models, including full information. Our methods suggest natural tests for full information and can be used to forecast how consumers will respond to additional information. We verify in a lab experiment that our approach succeeds in recovering preferences when consumers engage in costly search.
abstract_zh: 我们给出一个充分条件，在此条件下，当消费者选择并非完全知情时，仅凭选择数据即可识别消费者偏好。假设：（i）数据生成过程是一个搜索模型，其中消费者未观察到的属性被计量经济学家观察到；（ii）若消费者搜索商品j，则她也会搜索在效用的非隐藏成分方面优于j的商品；（iii）消费者在已搜索商品中选择总效用最大化的商品。经典模型将存在偏误：隐藏属性的价值会被低估，因为消费者对未搜索商品的属性变化无反应。在上述条件及额外温和限制下，一种利用选择概率的交叉导数来恢复偏好的替代方法，无论搜索协议如何均能成功，因此对消费者是否知情具有稳健性。该方法涵盖包括完全信息在内的若干标准模型。我们的方法为完全信息提供了自然检验，并可预测消费者如何响应额外信息。我们通过实验室实验验证，当消费者进行有成本搜索时，该方法能成功恢复其偏好。

title: The impact of income support measures on material deprivation: the case of Italy
title_zh: 收入支持措施对物质匮乏的影响：以意大利为例
title_primary: 收入支持措施对物质匮乏的影响：以意大利为例
title_secondary: The impact of income support measures on material deprivation: the case of Italy
authors: Marina De Angelis, Piero Esposito
official: 官方在线 2025-09-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The topic of measures to fight against poverty is one of the most debated by decision-makers, commentators, and insiders in Italy. After a short life, despite the increase in poverty and inequalities in Italy, the universal income support measures were abolished in 2023. This paper presents a counterfactual impact evaluation of the Inclusion Income (II), Italy’s first income support measure, on severe material deprivation from 2017 to 2021. We rely on a novel database collected from a survey addressed to beneficiary and non-beneficiary but eligible families of universal income support measures in Italy. Our results show a positive impact of the monetary benefit on the probability of not being severely materially deprived in 2019 but not in 2021. The in-kind part of the benefits, namely the socio-economic reinsertion personalized project, is, instead, effective after 2019, confirming its importance in addressing structural disadvantages and providing a long-term solution to material deprivation for the most disadvantaged groups. Results also show that the in-kind benefit is more effective in the South. Policy implications concerning the potential effectiveness of the polices replacing the II are discussed.
abstract_zh: 意大利决策者、评论人士及业内人士对反贫困措施议题的争论最为激烈。尽管贫困与不平等现象持续加剧，意大利的全民收入支持措施在实施短短数年后，于2023年被废止。本文基于反事实影响评估方法，考察了意大利首个收入支持措施——包容性收入（II）在2017至2021年间对严重物质匮乏的影响。我们利用一项针对意大利全民收入支持措施受益家庭与符合条件但未受益家庭的新型调查数据库展开研究。结果表明：2019年货币福利对降低严重物质匮乏概率具有正向效应，但该效应在2021年未显现。而福利中的实物部分——即社会经济再融入个性化项目——在2019年后持续发挥效力，证实其在解决结构性劣势方面的重要性，并为最弱势群体摆脱物质匮乏提供了长期解决方案。研究还发现，实物福利在意大利南部地区效果更显著。本文讨论了替代II政策的潜在有效性及其政策启示。

title: Financial Stability with Fire Sale Externalities
title_zh: 具有甩卖外部性的金融稳定性
title_primary: 具有甩卖外部性的金融稳定性
title_secondary: Financial Stability with Fire Sale Externalities
authors: Ryuichiro Izumi, Yang Li
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-09-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Do policies mitigating fire sale externalities improve financial stability? We study this question in a model of financial intermediation where banks are subject to self‐fulfilling bank runs and may sell long‐term assets subject to cash‐in‐the‐market pricing. Without regulations, banks hold more long‐term assets than socially optimal, causing inefficiently large fire sales in crises. Policymakers may regulate to mitigate this externality, but lack commitment. The optimal policy depends on how regulation affects the probability of self‐fulfilling runs, and we offer a robust control theory of this relationship. Ignoring this effect could inadvertently increase fragility and lower welfare. Internalizing it robustly increases welfare.
abstract_zh: 缓解抛售外部性的政策能否提升金融稳定性？我们在一个银行面临自我实现的挤兑风险且可能以市场现金定价出售长期资产的金融中介模型中研究这一问题。在无监管状态下，银行持有的长期资产规模超过社会最优水平，导致危机期间出现低效的大规模抛售。政策制定者可通过监管缓解这一外部性，但缺乏承诺能力。最优政策取决于监管如何影响自我实现挤兑的概率，我们为此关系提供了稳健的控制理论。忽视这一效应可能无意中加剧脆弱性并降低福利，而将其内生化则能稳健地提升福利。
